triggering_base_only_evaluation.interpretation: Qwen3-1.7B exposes long reasoning traces but does not reach the registered final JSON within 512 tokens, so a single generation cannot serve as both the behavioral endpoint and the local trace artifact.

secondary_trace_lane.adapter_checkpoint: selected only after the primary behavioral curve is scored
secondary_trace_lane.sentinel_policy: one prospectively selected held-out variant per family
secondary_trace_lane.role: alternative-search, evidence-use, revision, and termination analysis; not the behavioral reward denominator

rationale: The user requested reasoning traces, and those traces are retained. Separating the full behavioral lane from the bounded trace lane prevents universal trace truncation from masquerading as zero behavioral capability while keeping process evidence available.
claim_boundary: This is a prospective measurement repair based only on base-model truncation. No adapter was trained or inspected before the two lanes were frozen.
